title: Other Kitchen
summary:
Caleb Wright is summoned line cook who joins the quest after the plates are cleared. The life that shows in public is anchored at Guildhall pass, First City. Caleb was closing a kitchen and opened his eyes on a guild pass that serves adventurers. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Blunt, generous, and proud of a clean station. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: the confident routine was built the year they had nowhere to sleep and the person in front of them now resembles that old mistake. If that truth surfaces at Guildhall pass, First City, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
